yolo_aug.changes: mixup=.1, degrees=10; base also has native augmentation

faster_rcnn.seed_note: torch/NumPy seeded once to 42 in original notebook

ssd.seed_note: RNG continued after Faster R-CNN; no separate reset before SSD
ssd.original_loop_note: Original code skips nonfinite batches; no per-batch skip log was saved

efficientdet.initialization: verified COCO -> reset entire class_net to five classes
efficientdet.selection: maximum validation mAP50_95; first epoch on exact tie
efficientdet.data_geometry: original pixel XYXY -> resized pixel YXYX; classes 0..4 -> 1..5
efficientdet.prediction_cleanup: clamp all four coordinates; remove zero-area predictions; export confidence >= .001

historical_label_repair.reason: Original XML ymin=-1 clipped to image boundary ymin=0; other pixel coordinates preserved.
historical_label_repair.training_note: YOLO, Faster R-CNN and SSD checkpoints predate the one-pixel boundary repair; the current repaired DETR was trained afterward. Test stayed unchanged. EfficientDet also used the repaired training data.

new_training_defaults: Fresh runs use fixed seed per model; native PyTorch uses batch=1, accumulation=4. These are not rewritten historical configurations.
comparison_limits: Five architecture families; seven experiments; YOLO n/s are size variants.
Different training durations, initialization and hardware; this is not an equal-compute architecture ranking.
Rare-class val/test support is small; near duplicates were not checked.
metric_protocol: Common preserved scorer; original-pixel XYXY; AP101 at IoU .5:.95; micro P/R/F1 at conf=.25, IoU=.5

reference_evaluation_revision.reason: cuDNN deterministic flag changed numeric predictions; both historic and current exports exactly reproduced; current export repeated exactly.
reference_evaluation_revision.decision_rule: Keep the explicit existing pipeline settings, independently repeat them, then update only the proven SSD reference. No choice by best test mAP.
reference_evaluation_revision.comparison_note: Five model references unchanged; this is reevaluation of SSD, not a new training experiment.
